description: Query graph topology, neighborhoods, dependency paths, safe read-only SQL queries, and compact System One task slices. Supported actions: subgraph (fetch N-hop neighborhood around root node), trace (trace dependency chain upstream or downstream with cycle detection), raw (execute safe read-only SELECT query against SQLite), natural_language (translate natural language query into graph operations), compact_slice (fast System One decision slice).

action.description: The graph query action to execute.

direction.description: Direction of dependency traversal for trace.

edge_types.description: Allowed edge types for trace (default: depends_on, blocks, child_of).

query.description: Natural language search query for natural_language action.

root_id.description: Root node ID for subgraph query.

sql.description: Read-only SELECT query for raw action.

name: query_graph
